tools.name: Incenter
tools.description: Triangle incenter; uses the native triangle-center construction.

tools.name: IsogonalConjugate
tools.description: Isogonal conjugate in triangle ABC, using homogeneous barycentric products.

tools.name: IsotomicConjugate
tools.description: Isotomic conjugate in triangle ABC, using signed barycentric products.

tools.name: Conic
tools.description: Five point/tangent-line constraints in any order. Mixed constraints return a list of all real conics; segments and rays mean their supporting lines. Native point/coefficient forms are preserved.

tools.name: SecondIntersection
tools.description: Other intersection of a circle and the line through known point P and Q. P must be on the circle; reflection in the chord midpoint avoids selecting an intersection branch.
